title: Trooper relieved of duty after ex-girlfriend allegedly found him asleep in her bed
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Crime Michael McGuire allegedly climbed a fire escape to get into his ex’s South End apartment on Halloween night.

Charles Krupa / AP, File By Abby Patkin November 4, 2026 | 1:25 PM 2 minutes to read A Massachusetts State Police trooper who was knocked unconscious in a Quincy bar brawl over the summer has been relieved of duty after he allegedly broke into his ex-girlfriend’s South End apartment and fell asleep in her bed over the weekend.
Michael McGuire, 37, is charged with one count of breaking and entering in the nighttime, court records show.

title: Aldi to open its 26th Massachusetts store in Swansea
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Business The discount grocer opens Thursday, offering giveaways to its first 200 shoppers.
Inside of an Aldi store Handout, Aldi South Coast shoppers looking to save a few bucks will soon have a new place to fill their carts.

Aldi will open its 26th Massachusetts store Thursday at 58 Swansea Mall Drive in Swansea, giving the first 200 customers a gift bag filled with product samples and a gift card through its Golden Ticket giveaway program.
